description: Header file defining utility functions related to OS operations such as string conversions and MAC address validation.

methods.name: os_strtoul
methods.description: Converts a string to an unsigned long with specified base.

methods.name: os_atol
methods.description: Converts a string to a long integer.

methods.name: os_atof
methods.description: Converts a string to a double.

methods.name: os_util_strncpy
methods.description: Safely copies a string with limit.

methods.name: os_util_is_valid_mac_str
methods.description: Validates if a string is a properly formatted MAC address.
